g.text: Sliding Window: 暴力枚举所有位置和尺度 (exhaustive search)
Faster R-CNN: learned proposal generation → two-stage (dense→sparse)
SSD: 删除 proposal stage → single-stage dense prediction
FPN: top-down pathway 把 strong semantics 传回 high-res feature map
RetinaNet: Focal Loss 解决 dense detection 极端 class imbalance
FCOS / Anchor-Free: 删除 handcrafted anchor template, point → (l, t, r, b)
